node.statement: By def-epsilon-cstar-algebra, bold-dot is complex-bilinear and dagger is conjugate-linear, hence bold-dot is real-bilinear and dagger is real-linear; therefore A=P+Q maps through the fixed-parenthesized expression defining f_V by sums and compositions of real-linear and real-bilinear maps, so Phi_V is a real polynomial of degree at most two and is C^infinity in finite dimension.
